children.text: Whether you’re a parent, student, or visitor, feel free to reach out with your questions, feedback, or inquiries. Our team is here to support you.

heading.title: We’d Love to Hear From You

image.alt: Sharjah American International School - Abu Dhabi campus building

children.text: Our After-School Activities programme offers students the opportunity to explore their interests, develop new skills, and gain valuable experiences in a variety of fields beyond the classroom. Led by dedicated staff and conducted under school supervision, these activities encourage creativity, teamwork, leadership, and personal growth in a safe and engaging environment. A wide range of activities is announced at the beginning of each academic year, allowing students to choose those that best match their interests and talents.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi students playing basketball during after-school activities

children.text: From the Sustainability Club and Power Club, where students engage in STEAM and robotics, to TED Talks, public speaking forums, and Arabic Story Writing Competitions, students develop creativity, confidence, critical thinking, and communication skills.

heading.title: Students at SAIS - Abu Dhabi are encouraged to explore their passions through a wide range of enriching opportunities.

children.text: Beyond the classroom, students participate in volunteering initiatives and student committees, where they grow their talents, develop leadership skills, and make meaningful contributions to the school and wider community.
At SAIS - Abu Dhabi, student life extends beyond academics, it’s where talents are nurtured, leaders are inspired, and every student is empowered to make a positive impact

cards.title: Senior Committee

cards.description:
Promotes UAE heritage, culture, traditions, and national identity.

Objectives:
•	Celebrate UAE National Day
•	Promote Emirati culture
•	Support national initiatives
•	Develop global citizenship

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi Emirati heritage majlis corner

cards.title: National Identity Committee

cards.description: The Happiness Committee is dedicated to promoting positive mental health, kindness, inclusion, and wellbeing across the school community. Through a range of initiatives, the committee fosters a supportive and welcoming environment, encourages healthy lifestyles, celebrates student achievements, and strengthens a positive school culture where every student feels valued and supported.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi students smiling together in class

cards.title: Happiness Committee

cards.description: The Radio Station Committee gives students the opportunity to develop their communication, confidence, and presentation skills by preparing and delivering school announcements. Members work as a team to share important news, celebrate achievements, and keep the school community informed through engaging broadcasts.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi students broadcasting from the school radio studio

Develops compassion, volunteerism, and humanitarian responsibility through charitable initiatives in partnership with the Emirates Red Crescent.

Objectives:
•	Promote volunteer work
•	Support local communities
•	Organise fundraising
•	Participate in humanitarian campaigns

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi students walking with their teacher in the girls section

cards.title: Red Crescent Committee

cards.description: The Sustainability Committee promotes environmental awareness and encourages sustainable practices throughout the school community. Through projects and campaigns, the committee works to reduce waste, encourage recycling, promote the conservation of natural resources, and support the UAE’s sustainability goals by inspiring students to make environmentally responsible choices.

Through creativity and teamwork, members help showcase the school’s achievements, activities, and community spirit.
